perf.summary: Same fixed(&this) pinning per access as byte4; the ushort3 indexer is used in RasterizeTriangles(ushort3* tris) per triangle (tris[i].x/.y/.z), so a pin-free switch helps the rasterization driver loop.
perf.currentCost: RasterizeTriangles with ushort3 reads tris[triIndex].x/.y/.z — though these are direct field reads, the general indexer (when used) pins via `fixed (ushort3* array = &this)`. Direct .x/.y/.z avoid it, but any [index] usage incurs the pin.
perf.proposedChange: Provide a `switch`/`Unsafe.Add(ref Unsafe.As<ushort3,ushort>(ref this), index)` indexer to drop the fixed region; keep direct .x/.y/.z field access in the rasterization loop (already done there).
perf.rationale: Pin-free element access keeps the small struct in registers and avoids forcing it to the stack, marginally improving any code path using the indexer under Burst.
perf.risk: Must match index 0..2 semantics; guarded bounds check stays under ENABLE_UNITY_COLLECTIONS_CHECKS. Very low impact because the hot rasterization path already uses .x/.y/.z directly, not the indexer.
